content_sections.heading: About VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital
content_sections.text: V.M.M.C & Safdarjung Hospital is a Government of India medical college and hospital in New Delhi, with its recruitment handled through the Office of the Director. Its satellite centre, the Rural Health Training Centre (RHTC), Najafgarh, has 31 of the advertised posts. This recruitment is issued by the Nodal Officer (SR), Academic Section, VMMC & SJH.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 470 Senior Resident posts are advertised: 439 at VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital (including 86 backlog reserved vacancies, i.e. SC-24, ST-17 and OBC-45) and 31 at RHTC, Najafgarh. In addition, 29 posts (including 2 posts for RHTC) are reserved horizontally for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) (Divyangjan), including backlog vacancies, as per DOPT, Govt. of India Rules. The combined department-wise table is below. The 31 posts at the Rural Health Training Centre (RHTC), Najafgarh are already included in the table above. Their break-up is:

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Each department has its own qualification. For all MBBS-based posts, the qualification must be recognized by NMC and the candidate must be registered with the Delhi Medical Council before joining. For the two Dental Surgery posts, the MDS must be recognized by DCI and the candidate must be registered with the Delhi Dental Council before joining. For Emergency Medicine, the PG Degree/Diploma/DNB may be in any of these disciplines, or a qualification recognized equivalent thereto in the discipline/subject: Medicine Emergency Medicine Geriatric Medicine Anaesthesiology Pulmonary Medicine General Surgery Trauma Surgery Priority will be given to Emergency Medicine recognized by NMC. The crucial date for eligibility with reference to age and educational qualification is the last date of submission of application (25 November 2026). The candidate must have passed the PG examination on or before the last date of submission of application. In case of DNB, the results of both theory and practical should be declared on or before the last date of submission of application. The PG tenure completion date should be on or before 31 December 2026. The upper age limit is counted on the last date of submission of application. The notice prints no experience requirement, though candidates fill in previous Senior Resident experience, if any, in the application form. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each department.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Rs. 67,700/- in Pay Level-11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC, plus other allowances as admissible as per Govt. of India Rules. Tenure: three years, including any service rendered earlier as Senior Resident on adhoc/regular basis in any Govt. of India/State Government hospital/institution. Extension: the appointment will initially be for one year, which could be extended up to a total of three years on an annual basis, subject to a satisfactory work and conduct report from the concerned HOD. Rotation to RHTC: all Senior Residents recruited in Anaesthesia, Medicine, Obst & Gynae, Ophthalmology, Paediatrics, Psychiatry, SIC Ortho and Surgery will be posted at RHTC, Najafgarh on a brief rotational basis (as per requirement). Their teaching experience certificate will be issued by VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital. Other service conditions: as prescribed from time to time by the Govt. of India. Joining: the tentative date of joining is 10 days from the date of issue of the final result. Selected candidates collect the offer of appointment from the Academic Section; if acceptance is not received within the stipulated time, the offer stands cancelled and the post goes to the waiting list.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Screening Test, then a department assessment (interview) for qualified candidates, and a merit list on the combined marks. 1 mark is awarded for each correct answer. Negative marking of ¼ mark for each wrong answer. No negative marking for a non-attempted question. The admit card for the written examination is to be downloaded from www.vmmc-sjh.mohfw.gov.in . Candidates must bring a hard copy of the admit card with an original identity card (Aadhaar card, PAN card, voter card, driving licence or passport). Candidates three times the number of vacancies (or fewer if not available) who qualify the screening test will be called for the department assessment. Candidates with any publication, presentation of paper in CME/conference, or distinction/awards/medals during MBBS and post-graduation must bring copies at the interview; these will be considered for award of marks by the selection board. A merit list will be prepared on the combined marks of the Screening Test and the Assessment, and candidates equal to the number of vacancies will be selected in each category. A panel of waitlisted candidates equal to the number of vacancies will also be prepared, provided that many qualified candidates are available in each category.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there in VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 470 Senior Resident posts in 42 departments/specialties: 439 at VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital and 31 at RHTC, Najafgarh, with 29 posts reserved horizontally for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the VMMC Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted from 10 November 2026 to 25 November 2026 till 03:00 PM; any application received after 25 November 2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Safdarjung Hospital Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: MBBS with a PG Degree/Diploma/DNB in the specialty prescribed for the department, recognized by NMC, with Delhi Medical Council registration before joining; the Dental Surgery posts need MDS in Oral Surgery or Periodontics recognized by DCI with Delhi Dental Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for VMMC Senior Resident 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General/EWS, 48 years for OBC and 50 years for SC/ST candidates, counted on the last date of submission; it is relaxable for PwBD candidates as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 67,700/- in Pay Level-11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC, plus other allowances as admissible as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC candidates pay Rs.1200/- (non-refundable) through NEFT/RTGS, IMPS or UPI, and SC/ST/PWD candidates pay no fees.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Safdarjung Hospital Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-I form and the Annexure-II admit card, attach self-attested documents and the fee receipt, and submit it to the Diary & Dispatch Section of VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi-110029, or send it by post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for VMMC Senior Resident 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a one-hour, 60-mark MCQ Screening Test with ¼ negative marking, a 40-mark department assessment for candidates up to three times the vacancies, and a merit list on combined marks.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Senior Resident post at Safdarjung Hospital permanent?
faq.answer: No, the tenure is three years under the Residency Scheme, including earlier Senior Resident service; the appointment is initially for one year and could be extended annually, subject to a satisfactory report from the HOD.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply in more than one department?
faq.answer: No, a candidate can apply in only one department/specialty and submit only one application; otherwise the candidature will be cancelled.
